issue.title: High CPU utilization of syncd with 201911 BRCM image

failure.body:
**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1.  Download and install image:
https://sonic-jenkins.westus2.cloudapp.azure.com/job/broadcom/job/buildimage-brcm-201911/100/artifact/target/sonic-broadcom.bin

2.  sudo sonic-cfggen -H -k Seastone-DX010-25-50 --preset=t1 > config_db_t1.json

3.  sudo config reload config_db_t1.json -y

4, top

**Describe the results you received:**
```
admin@lnos-x1-a-csw03:~$ top
top - <IPV6> up 24 min,  1 user,  load average: 1.96, 2.45, 1.89
Tasks: 225 total,   2 running, 222 sleeping,   0 stopped,   1 zombie
%Cpu(s): 37.3 us, 14.0 sy,  0.0 ni, 48.0 id,  0.0 wa,  0.0 hi,  0.7 si,  0.0 st
KiB Mem :  4031152 total,  1403868 free,  1462428 used,  1164856 buff/cache
KiB Swap:        0 total,        0 free,        0 used.  2284064 avail Mem

  PID USER      PR  NI    VIRT    RES    SHR S  %CPU %MEM     TIME+ COMMAND
10877 root      20   0 1595652 358152  62032 S 181.1  8.9   5:14.43 syncd
11240 root      20   0  169220  33396   8396 S  20.9  0.8   0:33.96 python3.6
 1266 root      20   0   88776  19596   3276 S   7.6  0.5   2:38.88 redis-server
```

**Describe the results you expected:**
Syncd should not use that much CPU (181%) here.

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

    **Output of `show version`:**

    ```
admin@lnos-x1-a-csw03:~$ show ver

SONiC Software Version: SONiC.HEAD.100-7564b060
Distribution: Debian 9.12
Kernel: 4.9.0-11-2-amd64
Build commit: 7564b060
Build date: Sat Jun 20 <IPV6> UTC 2020
Built by: johnar@jenkins-worker-3

Platform: x86_64-cel_seastone-r0
HwSKU: Seastone-DX010-25-50
ASIC: broadcom
Serial Number: DX010B2F077427LK000011
Uptime: <IPV6> up 28 min,  1 user,  load average: 1.67, 2.01, 1.82
    ```

